title: Mobile Raku Workshops with Alternative Firing Options
source_quote: We offer a variety of customizable workshops that we can bring to you.
evidence_sentence: Mobile raku workshops can be booked at your location with pricing from $75–$800 depending on format and materials.
evidence_quote: For our Raku workshops we offer a variety of alternative firings options including Traditional Raku, Horsehair, Saggar, Obvara, and Naked Raku.
summary: Book customizable mobile raku workshops at your studio or event location. AlSi brings kilns, materials, and expertise. Pricing: $600–$800 full day, $75/hour (plus $50 trip charge) by the hour, or $800 with all materials included. Saggar, horsehair, obvara, and naked raku options available.
cost_text: $75/hour (plus $50 trip charge) · $600 full day · $800 full day with materials
